schedule_task.title: Weekday review nudge [wizloop:fixed-time-weekdays]
schedule_task.prompt:
[wizloop:fixed-time-weekdays] A scheduled run of the loop file adapters/fixtures/t3/fixed-time-weekdays.md. Do these steps in order. TIME below means the time now in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

1. Do this:
Ask for a review on each pull request still waiting for one, once.

2. Last, append `TIME fixed-time-weekdays ok WHAT` to .openwiz/home/fixed-time-weekdays/ok.log, where WHAT is one line saying what you did; or, if step 1 failed, `TIME fixed-time-weekdays failed WHY`.
